---
name: find-references
description: Find and organize credible sources for the theoretical background
disable-model-invocation: true
---
Find credible references relevant to the current meeting's theoretical background.

Prioritize:
1. Official product/framework documentation.
2. Standards or official technical specifications.
3. Reputable developer documentation and technical publications.
4. Relevant academic publications when needed.

For each proposed source, provide its author/organization, title, publication/update date if available, URL, and which claim it supports.

Never invent bibliographic metadata. Verify that each URL resolves and that the page supports the proposed claim when web access is available. Add verified entries to the current meeting's `references.bib` using valid BibTeX. Do not modify report prose unless asked. Flag sources that could not be verified.
